description: Jeff.remote over HTTP against a real jeff-server over a fake engine. 'exchanges' is every request the Python client sent (method, path, Authorization header, JSON body) and the server's recorded answer (status, content-type and x-request-id headers, body). An SDK replays a case by serving each recorded answer in order, after checking that its own request is the recorded one. 'connect' is the outcome of connecting (GET /v1/functions); 'results' is each action's result, or its error with the request_id the client attached. The case "a server from before the functions' aliases is accepted" was recorded against a server whose GET /v1/functions answer has no 'aliases' field (optional), which a client must accept.

cases.name: connect reads the served functions; decide sends the calls by full ID
